reply_text:
I found one dated forward-looking line from Sutskever in 2023, and it's borderline. None of the four claims you already have showed up in his own words on the pages I opened, and I found no new claim with a clear date.

**The one candidate.** In the Dwarkesh Patel podcast transcript (27 March 2023), he said AI's economic value "Next year is going to be larger and larger after that." It names a year, but it's about economic value rather than what AI can do, so it's close to the business forecasts your rules exclude. I've listed it so you can decide.

**What else I found:**
- **Statements about AGI with no date** (listed under undated):
  - In the same Dwarkesh interview he described "a good multi-year window" lasting "from now till AGI." He also said, "I hesitate to give you a number."
  - The MIT Technology Review profile (26 October 2023) quotes him saying "At some point we really will have AGI."
  - A transcript of his TED talk says "the day will come" when AI matches or beats human brains. The transcript site dated its post 21 November 2023; I didn't confirm when the talk was given.
- **Left out:**
  - In the MIT profile he says that when researchers hit an obstacle, "within six months or a year" they find a way around it. That describes a past pattern rather than predicting something.
  - The four-year superalignment goal appears in that article only in the reporter's words, credited to OpenAI.
  - The Tel Aviv University article (5 June 2023) has "the next decade," but Sam Altman said it, not Sutskever.

**Gaps:**
- The Eye on AI transcript page (15 March 2023) returned "Not Found", so I quote nothing from it.
- The No Priors episode (2 November 2023) wouldn't open, and I found no transcript.
- The Dwarkesh page cut off partway through, so I didn't see its last sections.
- I used all six page openings, which left none for any further pages a search might turn up.
